title: fix(insights): make sure change in userToken can't reset the search parameters
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!
  Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request.
-->

**Summary**

previously we relied on a configure widget to set the userToken and clickAnalytics parameters. Unfortunately when the insights middleware is the first parameter, and you have a userToken set via cookie, the widget is removed and added again (setUserTokenAndSearch is called twice), and thus a change event is triggered before the other widgets are even mounted.

**Result**

<!--

Helper methods are used to prevent a change event being called by setting or updating userToken. It still triggers a new search as expected

fixes https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/5100
